text: Follow-up (after 102.001-T lands): update the upstream spike/SKILL.md.tmpl in the external autoharness repo so regeneration preserves the in-repo docline findings-artifact fix (Principle IV, no out-of-tree writes). Refs: 102.001-T, 102-F, docs/exec-plans/2026-07-13-spike-findings-docline-reconciliation-plan.md.

Upstream autoharness handoff: update external templates/agents/stage.agent.md.tmpl, templates/skills/plan-review/SKILL.md.tmpl, templates/skills/impl-plan/SKILL.md.tmpl, and templates/skills/harvest/SKILL.md.tmpl so regeneration preserves fail-closed formal plan-review provenance; uniquely parsed final-ledger/canonical-digest validation; repository-native atomic lock/CAS reserve, owner/token/phase checks, and stage_managed versus direct_harvest completion semantics; legacy bypass reconciliation; direct-harvest zero-mutation enforcement; and explicit Constitution Check output. Principle IV boundary: all four templates are outside C:\Source\GitHub\backlogit; do not write them here or add this handoff to an in-repo shipment. Closure requires external changes to land, regeneration of all four in-repo .github targets, and parity checks proving every listed contract survives regeneration.

Add a supported, atomic shipment hold/requeue lifecycle for staged-but-unapproved work: queued -> blocked and blocked -> queued, with core and CLI tests ensuring requeue restores normal ClaimShipment item activation. Generic artifact updates currently permit shipment status blocked even though shipment lifecycle/ClaimShipment cannot resume it; shipments 094-S and 095-S must remain fail-closed until this prerequisite lands or an explicit operator-approved replacement-shipment procedure is used. Keep this Go/CLI concern width-isolated from planning-governance template work.

Add a repo-native harvested-provenance repair command (for example stash link-harvested <stash-id> <artifact-id>) that atomically stamps supported source_stash_* custom fields on an existing artifact and harvested_artifact_id/reason on its archived stash record, then rehydrates without dropping the link. Required current repair: 8CD8F46A -> 105-F, CA877CD1 -> 105.004-T (grouped Constitution Check task), and A4BE2FAD -> 106-F. Current CLI exposes no arbitrary custom-field or archived-stash provenance mutation, so Principle IX forbids raw JSONL/Markdown edits. Include duplicate/mismatch/rollback tests and preserve blocked statuses.

Extend optional size estimation to feature and shipment artifacts. Define level-specific size semantics for feature versus shipment; add size_source and size_ruleset_version metadata plus estimate-history behavior; expose derived composition/rollups without persisting derived values as though they were human-authored estimates.
